name: CCI and Martin
summary: This EA uses the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator to generate trade signals and applies a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade. It opens buy positions when CCI is oversold and sell positions when CCI is overbought, relying on eventual mean reversion to recover losses. The Martingale approach makes it inherently high-risk, as a prolonged losing streak can rapidly deplete the account.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指标）生成交易信号，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后加倍仓位。它在CCI超卖时开多单，在CCI超买时开空单，依赖价格的均值回归来挽回损失。马丁格尔策略使其风险极高，连续亏损可能迅速耗尽账户资金。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI指标的均值回归信号与马丁格尔资金管理的结合。入场条件为CCI指标进入超卖区域（通常低于-100）时开多单，CCI进入超买区域（通常高于+100）时开空单。出场条件依赖于止盈目标，当持仓盈利达到预设目标时平仓。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔策略，每次交易亏损后将下一单的手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面，初始手数较小，但随亏损次数增加手数呈指数增长，没有设定最大加倍次数限制。该策略在震荡行情中可能有效，但在单边趋势行情中连续亏损将导致仓位急剧放大，面临爆仓风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines CCI-based mean reversion signals with a Martingale money management system. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the CCI indicator enters oversold territory (typically below -100) and a sell when CCI enters overbought territory (typically above +100). Exit conditions rely on a take-profit target, closing positions when a preset profit level is reached. Position sizing follows the classic Martingale approach, doubling the lot size after each consecutive loss in an attempt to recover all previous losses with a single win. Money management starts with a small initial lot size, but positions grow exponentially with each loss, and there is typically no hard cap on the number of doublings. This strategy may work in ranging markets but faces catastrophic drawdown risk in trending markets where consecutive losses cause position sizes to escalate uncontrollably.

parameters.name: Overbought_Level
parameters.description: CCI超买阈值，高于此值开空单
parameters.description_en: CCI overbought threshold; sell above this level

parameters.name: Oversold_Level
parameters.description: CCI超卖阈值，低于此值开多单
parameters.description_en: CCI oversold threshold; buy below this level

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 马丁格尔乘数，亏损后手数倍增系数
parameters.description_en: Martingale multiplier for lot size after loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

pros: CCI指标是经典的超买超卖指标，信号逻辑清晰易懂
在震荡市中，均值回归配合马丁格尔可能快速回本
初始手数较小，给账户一定的缓冲空间
参数可调，用户可根据风险偏好调整乘数和CCI阈值
代码结构相对简单，便于理解和修改
pros_en: CCI is a well-established overbought/oversold indicator with clear and interpretable signal logic
In ranging markets, mean reversion combined with Martingale can recover losses quickly
The small initial lot size provides some buffer for the account
Parameters are adjustable, allowing users to tune multiplier and CCI thresholds to their risk tolerance
The code structure is relatively simple, making it easy to understand and modify
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数指数增长，爆仓风险极高
没有止损设置（StopLoss=0），亏损头寸没有保护
没有最大加倍次数限制，可能导致无限递增的仓位
CCI在强趋势行情中会持续发出错误信号，加剧马丁格尔的亏损
不考虑账户余额和保证金比例，可能在保证金不足时仍尝试开仓
cons_en: The Martingale strategy causes exponential lot size growth during consecutive losses, creating extremely high risk of account blow-up
No stop loss is set (StopLoss=0), leaving losing positions completely unprotected
No maximum doubling limit, potentially leading to infinitely escalating position sizes
CCI generates persistent false signals during strong trends, compounding Martingale losses
Does not account for account balance or margin ratio, potentially attempting to open positions when margin is insufficient
improvements: 增加最大马丁格尔加倍次数限制，防止手数无限增长
添加硬止损保护，避免单笔交易亏损过大
增加账户余额和保证金检查，在保证金不足时停止交易
加入趋势过滤器（如均线方向），在逆趋势时暂停开仓
增加最大回撤限制，达到阈值时停止所有交易
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale doubling limit to prevent unlimited lot size growth
Implement a hard stop loss to avoid excessive single-trade losses
Add account balance and margin checks to stop trading when margin is insufficient
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to pause entries against the prevailing trend
Add a maximum drawdown limit that halts all trading when the threshold is reached

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略手数指数增长，连续亏损可致爆仓
无止损设置，单笔亏损无上限
无最大加倍次数限制，仓位可无限递增
CCI在趋势行情中持续发出反向信号，加剧亏损
缺乏保证金检查，可能在资金不足时仍尝试下单
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy causes exponential lot growth; consecutive losses can blow up the account
No stop loss means single trade losses have no upper bound
No maximum doubling limit allows positions to escalate indefinitely
CCI persistently generates counter-trend signals in trending markets, compounding losses
Lack of margin checks may attempt to place orders even when funds are insufficient
